about: Sub-shetachim: a regional director's area under a head shliach. They show only with the map's Sub-shetachim switch, never on the head shluchim's map (owner, Oct 26: "I meant as a separate thing to toggle to see sub shetachim not in the head shluchim part"). Each is ONE piece with borders of its own (owner, Nov 1: "why are you using county situations you should be drawing your own borders"; then "Why the fuck have you made disconnected ones like the valley and inland empires with horrible borders"): the land its member houses span (the triangles between them and the links joining them all), reaching a little past them, rounded, and cut halfway to any of the shetach's other houses nearby. Members are listed (members: chabad.org ids), or are the parent shetach's houses within membersIn (US counties by Census GEOID, L.A. Times neighbourhoods by region or name, county subdivisions by name in one county, { box: [west, south, east, north], county? } (a box, or the part of a county in it), { near: [lon, lat], km }, { shape } (a shape of data/shapes: western Jalisco) or { state, minus? } (the shetach's area of a state, a Mexican state, less such shapes)), less exclude; mushrooms never count. Its outline (outline) is chosen region by region (owner, Nov 2: "use your discretion every time ... when you draw them each time individually you just have to think about it"): "areas", its member areas themselves, where those are the region (a county, its towns, its county divisions; ccds take names, or except: all but those, and a box to cut them); "drawn" (the default), drawn round its houses where no such lines fit; "both". A region over a state or national line is outlined as one shape. areas: whole areas of the map added as they are (the Baja peninsula; the Mexican regions, state by state). A border two regions share is drawn once (sub.json gives the second its copy apart, dup, for its outline when picked). reach / far (km, optional, drawn ones): how far past its houses it reaches whatever's round it (7), and over land clearly its own (50). Most shetachim have none, and none fills its shetach: the rest stays the head shliach's own. A vaad may lead one instead of a regional director (Queens, owner, Nov 3): vaad, vaadHe and vaadMembers ({ firstName, lastName, town }), its card's Leadership line opening to them; head / headHe is then the vaad's name on the map. scripts/build-sub.mjs makes web/data/sub.json (npm run build runs it).

subShetachim.name: San Diego & Baja
subShetachim.head: Yonah Fradkin
subShetachim.source: Chabadpedia (יונה פרדקין): the Rebbe's shliach in San Diego since 5736, "המשמש גם כשליח אזורי ומנהל תחתיו מערך מסועף של שלוחי הרבי", 26 couples under him in San Diego County as of 5782. The Baja peninsula is his too (owner, Oct 26: "baja peninsula is under fradkin"). Drawn round the county's houses (the metro, North County and the east county's towns), not the whole county's desert; and the peninsula's two states whole. Outline: San Diego County and the two Baja California states, drawn as one shape.

subShetachim.name: The Valley
subShetachim.head: Mordechai Einbinder
subShetachim.source: Chabad of the Valley (Tarzana). Its staff page (2004) lists its houses across the San Fernando Valley (Encino, Tarzana, Porter Ranch, North Hollywood, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Woodland Hills, Calabasas, Chatsworth, Northridge, CSUN) and, under it, the Conejo (Rabbi Moshe Bryski, "Conejo Regional Director": Agoura, Westlake, Oak Park, Thousand Oaks), Ventura (Rabbi Yakov Latowicz), Simi Valley (Rabbi Noson Gurary) and the Santa Clarita Valley (Rabbi Choni Marozov), each called "Regional Director". Its founder, Rabbi Joshua B. Gordon, passed away 29 Shevat 5776 (Chabadpedia). The Jewish Journal (May 2, 2024) calls Rabbi Mordechai Einbinder the "leader of the sprawling Chabad of the Valley community based in Tarzana", 32 institutions. Its members, the houses on that list (the owner, Nov 1: "What about that 2004 thing? I'm sure that's still accurate as well"): those in the San Fernando Valley (the L.A. Times' region), Calabasas and Hidden Hills; the Conejo (Agoura Hills, Westlake Village, and Ventura County's Thousand Oaks county subdivision: Thousand Oaks, Newbury Park, Oak Park, North Ranch); Simi Valley; and the Santa Clarita Valley. Not Oxnard or Camarillo (the owner: "Oxnard and Camarillo are way way past the valley"; each has its own house, not on the list), nor Moorpark or Ojai; and so not Ventura either, though the 2004 list has it: it lies beyond Camarillo and Oxnard, and the region is one piece (the owner, Nov 1: "Why ... disconnected ones like the valley"), which can't reach it without them. Drawn round those houses, not the county lines (the owner: "why does it stretch so North"). Outline: drawn round its houses (Nov 2: its neighbourhoods and subdivisions put together made a jagged patchwork that ran up to Camarillo's edge; drawn, it stops short of Camarillo, Moorpark and the Malibu coast). Nov 3: checked against Chabad of the Valley's own "Valley Centers" list (chabadofthevalley.com, 28: Tarzana, Encino, North Hollywood, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Woodland Hills, Chatsworth, Northridge, CSUN, Porter Ranch, Granada Hills, Calabasas, West Hills, Lake Encino, Toluca Lake, On Tampa (Reseda), Simi Valley, Santa Clarita Valley, Canyon Country, Agoura Hills; Westlake Village, Oak Park, Thousand Oaks, Newbury Park, Ventura, North Ranch, Pierce College, Lake Balboa). Not on it, so excluded though inside the areas: Chabad of Camarillo (Rabbi Aryeh Lang, 118595 — chabad.org pins it on Camarillo's east edge, inside Ventura County's Thousand Oaks division; owner, Nov 3: "why the fuck is Camarillo part of it") and Chabad of Burbank (the Kornfelds, 118319). Universal City (Studio City's rabbi), Wood Ranch (Simi Valley's) and Canoga Park, all among its houses, stay. Ventura is on the list but stays out, as the owner ruled.

subShetachim.name: Southern Nevada
subShetachim.head: Shea Harlig
subShetachim.source: Chabad of Southern Nevada, founded in 1990 by Rabbi Shea and Dina Harlig, with its affiliated houses around Las Vegas (Summerlin, Green Valley, the East, Southwest, the Hebrew Center and UNLV: the Chabad Times, April 2000, in UNLV's special collections; a 2014 UNLV oral history: as its director he "has helped establish seven Chabad locations throughout the community"). Drawn round its houses in the Las Vegas valley, not all of Clark County. Outline: Clark County, the southern part of the state (owner, Nov 2: "it looks better before how you had it as like that part of the state").

subShetachim.name: Northern Nevada
subShetachim.head: Mendel Cunin
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 1: "Do northern Nevada under Cunin". Chabad of Northern Nevada in Reno, Rabbi Mendel Cunin its director (chabad.org), and the houses round it: Chabad Cares and the Learning Center (Reno), Chabad at UNR, Chabad of Carson City (Rabbi Levi Sputz) and Chabad at Lake Tahoe (Rabbi Mordechai Richler, Stateline). Its members: the houses in Washoe County (south of 40.3°N, below Pyramid Lake: the county runs on 200 km to Oregon, which the owner didn't want: "why does it stretch so North"), Storey County, Carson City and Douglas County; those are its outline too. And western Lyon County (Dayton, Mound House, Stagecoach), west of 119.3108°W, the line of Douglas County's east edge: no house there, but without it the outline had a deep bite between Storey, Carson City and Douglas (the owner, Nov 3: "Maybe just make the bight part of it").

subShetachim.name: Tucson
subShetachim.head: Yossie Shemtov
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 1: "Tucson/Vail is Shemtov no?". Chabad Lubavitch of Tucson, Rabbi Yossie Shemtov its executive director (chabad.org), and the houses round it: Chabad on River (Rabbi Ram Bigelman), Chabad of Oro Valley (Rabbi Ephraim Zimmerman), Chabad of Vail (Rabbi Yisroel Shemtov), the University of Arizona's Chabad House (Rabbi Shmulie Shanowitz). Its members, and its outline: Pima County's Tucson and Marana county divisions (not the county's empty west, Ajo and the Tohono O'odham Nation). Not Chabad of Cochise County (Rabbi Benzion Shemtov, Sierra Vista), 70 km off across the desert: the region is one piece (owner, Nov 1: "Why ... disconnected ones"), and no source makes it Tucson's branch.

subShetachim.name: Saint Petersburg
subShetachim.head: Mendel Pewzner
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 1: "Peterburg under Pewsner". Rabbi Mendel Pewzner, the Jewish Community of St. Petersburg at the Grand Choral Synagogue (chabad.org). Its members: Berel Lazar's shetach's houses within 45 km of the city's centre. Drawn round its houses, out to 25 km where the land is clearly its own: the city and its edges.

subShetachim.name: Long Island
subShetachim.head: Tuvia Teldon
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Tuvia and Chaya Teldon, regional directors of Chabad Lubavitch of Long Island since 1977 (Anash; COLlive, "In for the long haul"); Lubavitch.com (Sept 2025): "over 29 Chabad rabbis in 23 Chabad centers throughout Long Island". Its headquarters: Lubavitch of Long Island, Commack. Its members: the houses in Nassau and Suffolk Counties. Outline: Nassau and Suffolk Counties, the whole island.

subShetachim.name: The Bronx
subShetachim.head: Levi Shemtov
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 3: "Doesn't the Bronx have regional leadership". Rabbi Levi and Sorah Shemtov direct Chabad Lubavitch of the Bronx ("Chabad of the Bronx") from Riverdale, since 1992: COLlive (May 2025) signs them "Chabad Lubavitch of the Bronx, Riverdale, New York"; CrownHeights.info (Dec 2018, Bronx Jewish Hall of Fame): he "directs Chabad of the Bronx with his wife, Sarah", and Chabad of the Bronx was "commended on a new center that opened before the High Holidays in South Bronx" (the Mishulovins); Bronx Times (Jan 2023): he was raising funds for a Pelham Parkway Chabad Center and its couple. Its members: the houses in Bronx County. Outline: Bronx County.

subShetachim.name: Queens
subShetachim.head: Vaad Hashluchim
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 3: "the queens tat shetach with its va'ad". The Vaad Hashluchim of Queens, an elected body: "Organized by the duly elected Vaad Hashluchim of Queens" (CrownHeights.info, July 28 2023, the first Queens Kinus Hashluchim, Adria Hotel, Bayside; "twenty families of Shluchim serving Queens"); its members Rabbis Yossi Blesofsky (Chabad of Northeast Queens, Bayside), Mendy Hecht (Chabad of Forest Hills North), Dov(i) Steinmetz (Chabad of Briarwood), Zev Wineberg (chabad.org's spelling; "Weinberg" in the article: JCC-Chabad of West Queens, Long Island City, chabad.org's Chabad of Long Island City) and Yerachmiel Zalmanov (Chabad of Eastern Queens) (Queens Jewish Link, Aug 2 2023, "Inaugural Kinus Held For Queens Shluchim"). Anash.org: "the Vaad Hashluchim said" (June 2023, Soul Encounters) and the second regional Kinus of "the Shluchim of Queens, representing 20 Chabad Houses" (Aug 2024); its YouTube channel is "Vaad Hashluchim of Queens". No chairman named. Its members: the houses in Queens County. Outline: Queens County.

subShetachim.name: Northwest New Jersey
subShetachim.head: Asher Herson
subShetachim.source: The Jewish Link: "Rabbi Asher Herson, regional director of the Chabad Center of Northwest NJ" (Rockaway); chabad.org lists its branches as "Chabad of Northwest NJ – Western Region" (Flanders, Rabbi Yaacov Shusterman) and "Chabad of Northwest NJ – Berkshire Valley" (Wharton, Rabbi Levi Naparstek). Its members: those three, and the houses in Sussex and Warren Counties (Chabad of Sussex County). Members and outline (Nov 2): Sussex and Warren Counties and northwest Morris County's townships (Jefferson, Rockaway, Wharton, Dover, Mine Hill, Roxbury, Mount Olive, Netcong, Mount Arlington, Washington, Victory Gardens): not Morristown's, Randolph's, Mendham's or Boonton's.

subShetachim.name: St. Louis
subShetachim.head: Yosef Landa
subShetachim.source: chabad.org: "Chabad of Greater St. Louis Regional Headquarters", Rabbi Yosef Landa its "Co-Founder and Regional Director"; the St. Louis Jewish Light calls him and his wife Shiffy its regional directors. Its members: the houses in St. Louis County, the City of St. Louis and St. Charles County (Chabad of St. Charles County: his son Rabbi Chaim Landa). Outline: St. Louis County, the City and St. Charles County.

subShetachim.name: Northern Virginia
subShetachim.head: Sholom Deitsch
subShetachim.source: JNS: Rabbi Sholom Deitsch, "regional director of Chabad Lubavitch of Northern Virginia"; the Washington Jewish Week: he and his wife Chanie opened it in January 1991 and "expanded to eight more Chabad locations throughout Northern Virginia from 2001 to 2021, including Alexandria, Loudoun County and Springfield". Its members: the houses in Fairfax, Arlington, Loudoun and Prince William Counties and the cities of Alexandria, Fairfax, Falls Church, Manassas and Manassas Park. Outline: its counties and cities.

subShetachim.name: Tidewater
subShetachim.head: Aaron Margolin
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 3: "I want all possible sub shatachim". Chabad Lubavitch of Tidewater (Norfolk, 1979), Rabbi Aaron (Aron) Margolin its executive director, with his brother-in-law Rabbi Levi Brashevitzky's family (Jewish News VA, "HAT graduate moves home to serve community as rabbi"); it serves "Chesapeake, Hampton, Norfolk, Portsmouth, and Suffolk" (the Tidewater federation's directory), and his son Rabbi Zalman Margolin moved to Virginia Beach "to expand Chabad of Tidewater with a new presence near the Virginia Beach Oceanfront" (Jewish News VA; not on the map yet: its address isn't sure, 210B 54th Street in 2018, 300 Holly Road later). Chabad of Williamsburg (Rabbi Mendy Heber) isn't its. Members and outline: the cities of Norfolk, Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Portsmouth, Suffolk and Hampton.

subShetachim.name: South Broward
subShetachim.head: Raphael Tennenhaus
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Raphael Tennenhaus, "director of Chabad activities in south Broward"; Chabad of South Broward is headquartered in Hallandale, a network of "11 Chabad centers in South Broward" (TorahCafe; the Jewish Press). Its members: Broward County's houses south of Fort Lauderdale (Hallandale Beach, Hollywood, Dania Beach, Davie, Cooper City, Pembroke Pines). Asked of the owner: whether Chabad Lubavitch of Southwest Broward (Rabbi Pinny Andrusier, Cooper City) and his sons' houses are his or a network of their own. Members and outline (Nov 2): Broward's Hallandale Beach, Hollywood and Miramar–Pembroke Pines county divisions (Hollywood, Hallandale, Dania, Pembroke Pines, Miramar), not a straight line across the county; so not Davie's division (Cooper City, Davie, Weston), where the Andrusiers' Southwest Broward network is (asked of the owner whether it is Tennenhaus's).

subShetachim.name: Greater Orlando
subShetachim.head: Sholom Dubov
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Sholom Ber Dubov, "Head Shliach to the Greater Orlando Area"; Chabad of Greater Orlando, founded 1984 (Maitland), its own pages: "Senior Rabbi & Executive Director". Under him: Rabbi Tzviky Dubov for Maitland, Winter Park, Casselberry, Oviedo and Winter Springs, his son-in-law Rabbi Yanky Majesky's Chabad of North Orlando (Lake Mary, Sanford, Longwood), and the seventh location, Altamonte Springs (2019); three of his wife's siblings "were appointed by Rabbi Dubov and work as emissaries in Central Florida" (Heritage Florida Jewish News; chabadorlando.org). Its members: the houses in Orange, Seminole and Osceola Counties. Outline (Nov 2): Orange and Seminole Counties and Osceola's Kissimmee and St. Cloud divisions (not Osceola's empty south, 100 km down to Lake Okeechobee).

subShetachim.name: Greater Austin
subShetachim.head: Yosef Levertov
subShetachim.source: Chabad of Greater Austin, directed by Rabbi Yosef and Rochel Levertov, and its branches: "The six Chabad centers in Austin include Chabad of Austin, the Rohr Chabad Jewish Student Center at the University of Texas at Austin, Chabad of South Austin, Chabad Young Jewish Professionals (YJP) and Downtown Austin, Chabad of Round Rock and Chabad of Leander", led by his son-in-law and sons (Shalom Austin; Anash). Its members: the houses in Travis and Williamson Counties, where those six are. Not San Marcos (Hays County, 40 km south): it isn't one of the six, and it would hang off the region on a long arm (the region is one piece; owner, Nov 1). Outline: Travis and Williamson Counties.

subShetachim.name: South Texas
subShetachim.head: Chaim Block
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 3: "I want all possible sub shatachim". Chabad Lubavitch of South Texas (San Antonio, 14535 Blanco Rd), Rabbi Chaim and Rivkie Block, sent by the Rebbe in 1985, "director of the South Texas Chabad-Lubavitch branch since 1985" (JLI; Benevity's registry, "Chabad Lubavitch of South Texas Inc"). Its houses: the Blocks' Chabad Center for Jewish Life & Learning, the Chabad Israeli Center and Chabad of Downtown SA in San Antonio, and Chabad of Boerne (Rabbi Yossi and Malkie Marrus, who "moved to San Antonio and became the second shluchim there" with the Blocks and opened Boerne in July 2022, "serving Boerne, Kendall, Kerr, and Gillespie counties"; COLlive, SACRD). Its members and outline: Bexar and Kendall Counties (Kerr and Gillespie, which Boerne also serves, left out: no house, and they made it a long L). Not in it: Corpus Christi (Chabad Coastal Bend), the Rio Grande Valley (McAllen) and San Marcos (Austin's) — no source ties them to it.

subShetachim.name: Greater Mercer County
subShetachim.head: Dovid Dubov
subShetachim.source: The Rabbinical College of America (New Jersey's regional headquarters) appointed Rabbi Dovid Dubov "to oversee Chabad Lubavitch of Greater Mercer County", its executive director; with the Friendship Circle of Greater Mercer County (Rabbi Shmuel Dovid Wilhelm) and the county's other houses (RCA; New Jersey Jewish News). Its members: the houses in Mercer County. Outline: Mercer County.

subShetachim.name: Bucks County
subShetachim.head: Yehuda Shemtov
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Yehuda Shemtov, executive director of Lubavitch of Bucks County (Newtown; Wikipedia on Rabbi Abraham Shemtov), with its branch Lubavitch of Central Bucks County West (Doylestown, Rabbi Mendel Prus; chabad.org) and the county's other houses. Its members: the houses in Bucks County. Outline: Bucks County.

subShetachim.name: Staten Island
subShetachim.head: Moshe Katzman
subShetachim.source: Chabad Lubavitch of Staten Island, Rabbi Moshe and Chana Katzman (chabad.org; its school, Mrs. Chana Katzman principal), and the island's houses run by their family: Chabad of the South Shore (Rabbi Levi Katzman), Chabad of Tottenville (Rabbi Mendel Katzman, serving Charleston, Pleasant Plains and Prince's Bay), associate director Rabbi Mendy Katzman (ChabadInfo; CrownHeights.info). Its members: the houses in Richmond County. Outline: Richmond County, the island.

subShetachim.name: Sarasota & Manatee
subShetachim.head: Chaim Steinmetz
subShetachim.source: Chabad Lubavitch of Sarasota and Manatee Counties, Rabbi Chaim Steinmetz (IRS; the Sarasota Mikvah), "three centers, a Mikvah, a preschool and a school" (CrownHeights.info), and his family's houses: Chabad of Downtown Sarasota (Rabbi Levi Steinmetz; Lubavitch.com, Dec 2025) and Bradenton (Rabbi Zev Steinmetz; chabad.org). Its members: the houses in Sarasota and Manatee Counties. Outline: Sarasota and Manatee Counties.

subShetachim.name: Tampa
subShetachim.head: Yossie Dubrowski
subShetachim.source: Chabad Lubavitch of Tampa Bay, Inc. (1988), Rabbi Yossie and Sulha Dubrowski, with its school; its South Tampa branch, Chabad Chai (Rabbi Mendy and Nechama Dina Dubrowski) (IRS; chabadchaicenter.com). Pinellas County has its own Chabad of Pinellas County, so it isn't in it. Its members: the houses in Hillsborough County. Outline: Hillsborough County.

subShetachim.name: North Broward & South Palm Beach
subShetachim.head: Yosef Biston
subShetachim.source: Chabad-Lubavitch of North Broward and South Palm Beach: Rabbi Yosef Biston its "executive vice president" (chabad.org), its headquarters chabad.org's "Chabad of Parkland – Regional HQ for North Broward & South Palm Beach"; he founded the Chabad Center of Margate in 1985 under that heading (a 2000 Chabad postcard). Its members: Broward County's houses north of Fort Lauderdale (Coral Springs, Parkland, Margate, Coconut Creek, Tamarac, Pompano Beach, Deerfield Beach, Lighthouse Point) and Palm Beach County's south of Boynton Beach (Boca Raton, Delray Beach), as the office's name has it. Members and outline (Nov 2): Broward's Coral Springs–Margate, Deerfield Beach and Pompano Beach county divisions, and Palm Beach County's Boca Raton, Boynton Beach–Delray Beach and Sunshine Parkway divisions south of Boynton (26.48°N, "south of Boynton").

subShetachim.name: Greater Sacramento
subShetachim.head: Mendy Cohen
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 3: "I want all possible sub shatachim". Rabbi Mendy Cohen, "regional Shliach to the Greater Sacramento region" (COLlive, "New Shluchim for Youth in Folsom"), founded Chabad of Sacramento with his wife Dinie in 1994 and "opened six additional centers in the region" (CrownHeights.info, the Kinus Hashluchim keynote notice); new shluchim to Elk Grove were appointed by Rabbi Cunin and Rabbi Cohen (Anash), and Folsom's and Lincoln's thank him (COLlive). Its members: the houses in Sacramento County and western Placer County (Folsom, Fair Oaks, Elk Grove, Roseville/Granite Bay, Lincoln, Auburn, and the Sacramento Jewish Academy); Placer cut at 120.85°W and 39.0°N, past Auburn and Lincoln, not up to Lake Tahoe; Sacramento County cut at 38.25°N, without its empty tail down the Delta. Davis, Vacaville, Grass Valley and Stockton stay Cunin's own: no source ties them to it. Outline: those areas.

subShetachim.name: Inland Empire
subShetachim.head: Sholom Harlig
subShetachim.source: Chabad of the Inland Empire (Rancho Cucamonga), "since its inception in 1989 under the direction of Rabbi Sholom and Chanie Harlig" (its own site), with the Chabad Jewish Center of Chino Hills (Rabbi Mendy Harlig, 2020). Its members: those two. Not Lake Arrowhead & Big Bear (Rabbi Zalmen Bernstein, up in the mountains), Riverside, Temecula or the Claremont colleges: no source ties them to it. Outline: San Bernardino County's Ontario county division (Chino, Chino Hills, Ontario, Rancho Cucamonga, Upland, Montclair), where both are.

subShetachim.name: Montgomery County
subShetachim.head: Shaya Deitsch
subShetachim.source: Lubavitch of Montgomery County (Fort Washington), Rabbi Shaya Deitsch its executive director, who "also supervises groups in Rydal and Chestnut Hill" (the Philadelphia Inquirer, 2013); its own site lists the Fort Washington headquarters, Rydal (Rabbi Zushe and Dini Gurevitz) and Lafayette Hill, with a Friendship Circle (jewishmc.com). Its members: Montgomery County's houses north of the Main Line (Fort Washington, Rydal, Lafayette Hill), within the county: not the Main Line's (a network of their own) nor Philadelphia's. Members and outline (Nov 2): Montgomery County's townships but the Main Line's (Lower Merion, Narberth: Chabad of the Main Line) and Cheltenham (on Philadelphia, with its Cheder).

subShetachim.name: Atlantic County & the Shore
subShetachim.head: Shmuel Rapoport
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Shmuel Rapoport "oversees Chabad of Atlantic County, which runs Chabad at the Shore in Margate" (Ventnor; chabad.org: its executive director); his family's houses round it: the Ventnor shul (Rabbi Avrohom Rapoport), Chabad of Stockton University (Galloway, Rabbi Meir Rapoport), and Cape May County's programmes in Wildwood (COLlive; the Jewish Link). Its members: the houses in Atlantic and Cape May Counties. Outline: Atlantic and Cape May Counties.

subShetachim.name: Passaic County
subShetachim.head: Michel Gurkov
subShetachim.source: The Chabad Center of Passaic County (Wayne), Rabbi Michel Gurkov, and its branches run by his family: the Chabad Center for Jewish Life of Upper Passaic County (Wanaque, Rabbi Mendy Gurkov, serving North Passaic County), Chabad Passaic Clifton, and its preschool; Rabbi Mayer Gurkov joined it for its preschool and the county's outreach (the Jewish Standard; chabad.org). Its members: the houses in Passaic County. Outline: Passaic County.

subShetachim.name: Dallas
subShetachim.head: Mendel Dubrawsky
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Mendel Dubrawsky, "regional director of Chabad-Lubavitch of Dallas" (in Dallas since 1984); new houses "joining the larger growing network of Chabad Houses under the auspices of Chabad of North Texas and the leadership of Rabbi Mendel Dubrawsky" (the Park Cities); "11 [Chabad Houses] in Dallas" (a Texas Chabad source); his son Rabbi Levi Dubrawsky's campus centre (UNT/DFW), Preston Hollow and the Friendship Circle (chabadofdallas.com; DOJLife; CrownHeights.info). Its members: the houses in Dallas, Collin, Denton and Rockwall Counties. Not Fort Worth and Tarrant County (Chabad of Fort Worth & Tarrant County, a name of its own). Outline: Dallas, Collin, Denton and Rockwall Counties.

subShetachim.name: Howard County
subShetachim.head: Hillel Baron
subShetachim.source: The Lubavitch Center of Howard County (Columbia), Rabbi Hillel Baron, and the county's houses round it, his family's: Chabad of Ellicott City (Rabbi Yanky Baron), Clarksville and Laurel (Chabad Ellicott City's own list of its four centres); "the 5 Chabad centers in Howard County" (a Howard County government document). Its members: the houses in Howard County. Outline: Howard County.

subShetachim.name: South Dade
subShetachim.head: Yakov Fellig
subShetachim.source: Chabad of Miami (Coconut Grove; "Serving Miami's Jewish Community since 1989"), Rabbi Yakov Fellig its director (chabad.org), and its branches page, "13 Branches Across South Dade": Downtown Coral Gables, Kendall & Pinecrest, Cutler Bay & Homestead, Chabad at UM (Coral Gables and South Miami), UM Jackson, West Kendall and the rest (chabadmiami.com). Its members: Miami-Dade's houses south of downtown and west of the bay (Coconut Grove, Coral Gables, South Miami, Kendall, Pinecrest, Palmetto Bay, Cutler Bay, Homestead, Key Biscayne): fourteen listings, its thirteen branches and their schools. Not Miami Beach or North Miami. Outline (Nov 2): Miami-Dade south of the Tamiami Trail (SW 8th Street, 25.765°N) and east of Krome Avenue (80.52°W, the county's urban edge): South Dade without the Everglades, Key Biscayne on its island. (Its county divisions don't fit: Kendale Lakes–Tamiami's runs up to Miami Lakes, Homestead's far into the Everglades.)

subShetachim.name: Southwest Florida
subShetachim.head: Yitzchok Minkowitz
subShetachim.source: Chabad Lubavitch of Southwest Florida (Fort Myers), "under the leadership of Rabbi Yitzchok Minkowicz", its director, "officially welcomed new emissaries" (the Jewish Federation of Greater Naples' Federation Star, June 2025); its houses round Fort Myers: Cape Coral, Bonita Springs & Estero, FGCU, the Israeli Center (chabad.org). Its members: the houses in Lee County. Not Naples (Chabad of Naples, Rabbi Fishel Zaklos, since 2004) nor Charlotte County (its own director): no source ties them to it. Outline: Lee County.

subShetachim.name: North Fulton
subShetachim.head: Hirshy Minkowicz
subShetachim.source: Chabad of North Fulton (Alpharetta), Rabbi Hirshy Minkowicz: it serves Alpharetta, Crabapple, Duluth, Johns Creek, Milton and Roswell, with "satellite offices in Roswell, Johns Creek, and Alpharetta" (the Atlanta Jewish Times' synagogue guides; chabadnf.org). Its members: north Fulton County's houses (Alpharetta, Roswell). Not Gwinnett's or Forsyth's, each its own. Members and outline (Nov 2): Fulton County's Roswell–Alpharetta county division (Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Milton, Roswell).

subShetachim.name: Western Monmouth
subShetachim.head: Boruch Chazanow
subShetachim.source: Chabad Lubavitch of Western Monmouth County (Manalapan), Rabbi Boruch and Tova Chazanow, its executive director: "the Holmdel Chabad is a branch of this organization" (the Jewish Link, 2025); it runs Yeshiva Bais Menachem and a Chabad Jewish Center at Brookdale Community College (CrownHeights.info; NJJN). Its members: Monmouth County's houses west of the shore (Manalapan, Freehold, Marlboro, Holmdel, Morganville). Members and outline (Nov 2): the townships of western Monmouth: Manalapan, Englishtown, Freehold (township and borough), Marlboro, Holmdel, Colts Neck, Millstone, Upper Freehold, Allentown, Roosevelt, Howell, Farmingdale.

subShetachim.name: East Valley
subShetachim.head: Mendy Deitsch
subShetachim.source: Chabad of the East Valley (Chandler, 1997), Rabbi Mendy and Shterna Deitsch, and the centre it opened in Ahwatukee: "We realized more Jews were attending our programs and we saw a need for a center over there" (Jewish News of Arizona; CrownHeights.info). Its members: those two. Mesa, Gilbert, San Tan Valley and ASU aren't in it: no source makes them its branches. Drawn round its two houses (the Chandler county division would take Gilbert's, Mesa's and Tempe's houses too).

subShetachim.name: Greater Hartford
subShetachim.head: Yosef Gopin
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Yosef and Miriam Gopin, sent by the Rebbe to Hartford in 1977 after nearly two years with Rabbi Yisrael Deren at UMass Amherst; Chabad House of Greater Hartford, West Hartford, since 1988. The Jewish Ledger's history of it (July 6, 2011): the University of Hartford programme from 1977 (now Chabad Chevra, Rabbi Yosef Kulek, 2003, "an affiliate of Chabad of Greater Hartford", begun under Gopin's direction); Camp Gan Israel (1979); "Chabad expanded farther into Greater Hartford starting in the mid-'90s, when Rabbi Joseph Eisenbach came to Litchfield" (his wife Mina is a Gopin daughter: Chabad of Northwest Connecticut, and Chabad of Waterbury); "In 1998, Rabbi Mendel Samuels was brought in to start Chabad of the Valley in Weatogue" (and its Gan Israel Hebrew School); Rabbi Yosef Wolvovsky, a son-in-law, in Glastonbury; his son Rabbi Shaya Gopin (Farmington Chabad). Gopin: "We have established 10 centers in the Greater Hartford area" (Jewish Ledger, July 2021). Under Deren (owner, Nov 4: "he's a tat shetach"): Gopin began as Deren's assistant in Amherst, where Deren had founded Chabad of Western and Southern New England c. 1974. Its members: those eight. Not UConn (Rabbi Shlomo Hecht) or Wesleyan (Rabbi Levi Schectman), where Gopin's programmes began: no source ties today's houses to him. Drawn round its houses.

subShetachim.name: Eastern Connecticut
subShetachim.head: Avrohom Sternberg
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Avrohom Sternberg, Director of Chabad of Eastern Connecticut in New London (and spiritual leader of Congregation Ahavath Chesed; chabad.org author page); chabad.org lists Rabbi Aizik and Mushky Schwei on its staff (Director of CTeen) and as the co-directors of Chabad of Norwich, its branch. Its members: those two. Under Deren's Connecticut (Sternberg led the farbrengen at Deren's statewide gathering of Connecticut shluchim, Anash, Jan 2024). Drawn round its two houses.

subShetachim.name: Brevard County
subShetachim.head: Tzvi Konikov
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Tzvi (Zvi) and Shulamit Konikov, appointed by the Rebbe in 1990 "as his emissaries to the Space & Treasure Coasts" (jewishbrevard.com) — "newly appointed Chabad emissaries to Brevard County" (Lubavitch.com, Apr 12, 2021); Chabad of the Space and Treasure Coasts, Satellite Beach, co-directed with Rabbi Mendel and Chaya Osdoba, with its Torah Academy, Camp Gan Israel and Hebrew school in Melbourne and, since 2019, the former Temple Israel building in Viera (Vero News, Aug 29, 2019). Owner, Nov 4: "Tzvi Konikov sub shetach Brevard County". Its members: Brevard County's houses, all his. Chabad of Vero Beach (Indian River County, the Rosenfelds) isn't in it: no source ties it to him. Outline: Brevard County.

subShetachim.name: South Bay
subShetachim.head: Eli Hecht
subShetachim.source: Chabad of South Bay (Lomita, its first minyan Rosh Hashanah 1973), Rabbi Eli Hecht, whom chabad.org lists as its "Regional Director"; his biography: "Regional Director of the South Bay area ranging from San Pedro to Gardena, Palos Verdes, Redondo Beach and Torrance" (chabadsb.org, About Rabbi Hecht). Its members: the houses of that area (Lomita, Torrance, Rancho Palos Verdes, Redondo Beach's two, San Pedro). Outline: the L.A. Times neighbourhoods of that area (San Pedro, the Palos Verdes peninsula, Lomita, Harbor City, Harbor Gateway, West Carson, Torrance, Redondo Beach, Gardena).

subShetachim.name: Greater South Bay
subShetachim.head: Yosef Levin
subShetachim.source: Chabad of Greater South Bay (Palo Alto, since 1980), Rabbi Yosef and Dena Levin: "centers in Palo Alto, Sunnyvale, Mountain View and at Stanford University" (Lubavitch.com, A Silver Anniversary for Chabad of Palo Alto); he "expanded the South Bay network to five centers" (J. Weekly); chabad.org lists Chabad of Mountain View's rabbi on its staff. Los Altos Chabad (Rabbi Ezzy and Nechama Schusterman, Mountain View) was "re-established in 2010 as an affiliate of Chabad Lubavitch of the Chabad of Greater South Bay" (J. Weekly's directory). Its members: those (Chabad of Greater South Bay and Chabad Palo Alto, Chabad at Stanford, Chabad Jewish Center of Mountain View, Chabad of Sunnyvale, Los Altos Chabad, and the Schustermans' Bay Area Friendship Circle in Palo Alto). Not Silicon Valley's and the Peninsula's other houses (Cupertino, Menlo Park, Redwood City, Portola Valley, Santa Clara, San Jose): no source makes them its branches. Drawn round its houses (one county division covers all of Silicon Valley).

subShetachim.name: Northeast Florida
subShetachim.head: Yoseph Kahanov
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Yoseph and Rivkie Kahanov, "head Shluchim to North East Florida", founders and directors of Chabad Lubavitch of Northeast Florida (Jacksonville), and its centers across the region: Chabad of Clay County was "the fifth Chabad Center to serve the growing Northeast FL region" (2011), with Chabad of Southside, Chabad at the Beaches and St. Augustine; Amelia Island's shluchim, Rabbi Levi and Mindy Katz, were "appointed by Rabbi Yosef and Rivkie Kahanov" (First Coast Chabad; CrownHeights.info; Anash). Its members: the houses of Duval, St. Johns, Clay and Nassau Counties. Outline: Duval, St. Johns, Clay and Nassau Counties.

subShetachim.name: Rochester
subShetachim.head: Nechemia Vogel
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Nechemia Vogel, head shliach to Rochester since 1981 (Chabadpedia), "director of Chabad of Rochester and regional head shliach" (Yeshiva World News, on the new shluchim to SUNY Geneseo), at the Kessler Family Chabad Center; the houses round the city under it (the Chabad Times' directory): the Rohr Chabad House at the University of Rochester (his daughter and son-in-law, the Yarases), Chabad Young Professionals (his son Moshe), Chabad of Pittsford, Chabad at RIT, and Chabad of Geneseo at SUNY Geneseo. Its members: the houses of Monroe County and of Livingston County (Geneseo). Outline: Monroe and Livingston Counties.

subShetachim.name: Vancouver Island
subShetachim.head: Meir Kaplan
subShetachim.source: The owner, Nov 3: "I want all possible sub shatachim". Rabbi Meir and Chani Kaplan "were sent to serve the entire island as Chabad Lubavitch emissaries in 2003" (The CJN, "Chabad builds Victoria's first new synagogue in 150 years"), directors of Chabad of Vancouver Island in Victoria; Chabad of Nanaimo and Central Vancouver Island "was established with the encouragement of Rabbi Kaplan" by his sister and brother-in-law, Rabbi Bentzi and Blumie Shemtov, in 2015 (Jewish Independent); Chabad on Campus at the University of Victoria, Rabbi Mendy and Mushka Stiefel (née Kaplan). Members and outline: Vancouver Island and the islands by it (data/shapes/vancouver-island.geojson, from the map's British Columbia).

subShetachim.name: Mexican Caribbean
subShetachim.head: Mendel Druk
subShetachim.source: Rabbi Mendel Druk, "director of Chabad-Lubavitch activities in the Riviera Maya and Mexican Carribean", who with Rabbi Moshe Kotlarsky appointed Playa del Carmen's shluchim, the Goldbergs (Chabad.org, "Playing and Praying in Playa del Carmen", Oct 25, 2010); in Cancún since 2007. The owner's shetach list (data/global-shetach-list.txt before Oct 2, 2026, when the owner made all of Mexico one shetach: "entire Mexico is Mayzlish"; its regions are now Rabbi Yosef Mayzlesh's sub-shetachim, owner, Nov 3: "Do all the Mexican sub shetachim like druk etc"): Mexican Caribbean — Campeche, Quintana Roo, Yucatán — Mendel Druk. Its members: Cancún (his center, mikvah and CTeen), Playa del Carmen (Goldberg), Tulum (Binyamini), Cozumel (Caplin); the Israeli backpacker houses outside Chabad of Mexico (Isla Mujeres, Holbox, Bacalar, Mérida) are mushrooms and don't count. Outline: the three states.

subShetachim.name: Jalisco
subShetachim.head: Avraham Srugo
subShetachim.source: The owner's shetach list (data/global-shetach-list.txt before Oct 2, 2026, when the owner made all of Mexico one shetach: "entire Mexico is Mayzlish"; its regions are now Rabbi Yosef Mayzlesh's sub-shetachim, owner, Nov 3: "Do all the Mexican sub shetachim like druk etc"): Jalisco — Jalisco, Colima — Avraham Srugo. Rabbi Avraham Srugo, "שליח חב״ד בחליסקו" for 26 years (Kikar HaShabbat); Chabad of Guadalajara and Chabad of Lake Chapala (Ajijic, with the Suareses) on chabad.org. Jalisco's western coast round Puerto Vallarta is Rabbi Shneur Hecht's (Nayarit). Outline: Jalisco without those six municipalities, and Colima.

subShetachim.name: Nayarit
subShetachim.head: Shneur Hecht
subShetachim.source: The owner's shetach list (data/global-shetach-list.txt before Oct 2, 2026, when the owner made all of Mexico one shetach: "entire Mexico is Mayzlish"; its regions are now Rabbi Yosef Mayzlesh's sub-shetachim, owner, Nov 3: "Do all the Mexican sub shetachim like druk etc"): Nayarit — Shneur Hecht, with western Jalisco round Puerto Vallarta (the municipalities of Puerto Vallarta, Cabo Corrientes, San Sebastián del Oeste, Mascota, Talpa de Allende and Tomatlán: the owner's choice, Oct 2, data/shapes/jalisco-costa-norte.geojson). Rabbi Shneur and Mushkie Hecht founded Chabad of Puerto Vallarta (chabad.org). Outline: Nayarit and those six municipalities.

subShetachim.name: Bajío
subShetachim.head: Daniel Huebner
subShetachim.source: The owner's shetach list (data/global-shetach-list.txt before Oct 2, 2026, when the owner made all of Mexico one shetach: "entire Mexico is Mayzlish"; its regions are now Rabbi Yosef Mayzlesh's sub-shetachim, owner, Nov 3: "Do all the Mexican sub shetachim like druk etc"): Bajío — Aguascalientes, Guanajuato, Michoacán, Querétaro, San Luis Potosí, Zacatecas — Daniel Huebner. Rabbi Daniel and Raizel Huebner, Chabad of San Miguel de Allende (chabad.org; Chabad of SMA Inc). Outline: the six states.

subShetachim.name: Nuevo León
subShetachim.head: Zalmy Srugo
subShetachim.source: The owner's shetach list (data/global-shetach-list.txt before Oct 2, 2026, when the owner made all of Mexico one shetach: "entire Mexico is Mayzlish"; its regions are now Rabbi Yosef Mayzlesh's sub-shetachim, owner, Nov 3: "Do all the Mexican sub shetachim like druk etc"): Nuevo León — Chihuahua, Coahuila, Durango, Nuevo León, Tamaulipas — Zalmy Srugo. Rabbi Shneor Zalmen Srugo, director of Jabad Monterrey (chabad.org). Outline: the five states.

subShetachim.name: Chiapas
subShetachim.head: Oren Raz
subShetachim.source: The owner's shetach list (data/global-shetach-list.txt before Oct 2, 2026, when the owner made all of Mexico one shetach: "entire Mexico is Mayzlish"; its regions are now Rabbi Yosef Mayzlesh's sub-shetachim, owner, Nov 3: "Do all the Mexican sub shetachim like druk etc"): Chiapas — Chiapas, Tabasco — Oren Raz. Rabbi Oren and Einat Raz, Chabad of Chiapas and its mikveh in San Cristóbal de las Casas (chabad.org; Chabadpedia). Outline: the two states.

subShetachim.name: Sinaloa
subShetachim.head: Chaim Raitport
subShetachim.source: The owner's shetach list (data/global-shetach-list.txt before Oct 2, 2026, when the owner made all of Mexico one shetach: "entire Mexico is Mayzlish"; its regions are now Rabbi Yosef Mayzlesh's sub-shetachim, owner, Nov 3: "Do all the Mexican sub shetachim like druk etc"): Sinaloa — Chaim Raitport. Rabbi Chaim and Tzirl Raitport, new shluchim to Mazatlán, "having no shluchim in the entire state" (COLlive, Aug 2, 2026); not on chabad.org yet (added by hand at the city's point). Outline: the state.

subShetachim.name: Westchester
subShetachim.head: Mrs. Rochel Butman
subShetachim.source: Chabad Lubavitch of Westchester County ("Chabad Central", 1228 North Avenue, New Rochelle) and the 11 centers its site lists across the county (Bedford and Pound Ridge, Briarcliff and Ossining, Bronxville, Larchmont and Mamaroneck, Pelham, the Rivertowns, Rye and Harrison, Scarsdale, White Plains, Yonkers, Yorktown). chabad.org lists Mrs. Rochel Butman as its director; Rabbi Velvel Butman is still called its executive director and head shliach (Westchester County, Jan 1, 2026; Anash, Apr 23, 2026), though one source says headquarters removed him. The owner, Nov 3: the head is in dispute ("machlokes") between Mrs. Butman and the one who runs it day to day (not Rabbi Butman): "Just do Mrs butman but add disputed"; her name on its card only, not on the map ("Don't make her name shown on the [sub] shetach only if you click it"). Its members: the houses of Westchester County. Outline: Westchester County.
